summary: The dashboard is a read-only presentation layer. It never trains models, never executes research scripts and never writes into research artifact directories.

layers.title: React research dashboard
layers.description: TypeScript SPA with server-state caching, responsive layouts, light/dark/system themes and accessible data tables.

layers.title: FastAPI read-only API
layers.description: Versioned /api/v1 endpoints with Pydantic response models, bounded pagination and explicit availability states.

layers.title: Artifact service
layers.description: Central loader for JSON, CSV and Parquet outputs, with mtime-aware in-memory caching and allowlisted roots.

layers.title: Research artifacts
layers.description: Existing results/, data/processed/, data/splits/ and data/raw/ outputs remain the source of truth.

layers.title: Maintained content
layers.description: Manually curated experiment metadata, findings, roadmap, journal and limitation notes live in web/content/.

data_flow: Versioned API envelope with source references
boundaries: No database: existing JSON, CSV and Parquet artifacts are the primary data store.
No model checkpoint loading: checkpoints are not read or executed by the dashboard.
No arbitrary filesystem access: clients never submit paths; figures and documents use fixed allowlists.
No writes to research data: the only mutable state is an in-memory cache.
No fabricated curves or missing metrics: unavailable data is shown as unavailable.
